full_text:
Team Intel: HOU

Talked to Mike Picollo today (Astros NE area scout). He’s going to see Duke Friday but knows him well (he went to St. Joe’s). Of the 3 draft eligible arms there he likes Duke the best because he thinks he's a starter in pro ball. Brought up Hunter Brown, Spencer Arrighetti, and AJ Blubaugh as examples of Houston doing well with lower mid-major starters. Has him 11-20 right now. He also said most of the other area guys have it in the same order (Coppola & Gaines are both seniors and definitely relievers).

full_text:
Call w/ MLB

Kranzler up for POY for draft league
